record_title: A finite divisor parametrization for weak Carmichael numbers 3^a p q
scientific_context: Weak Carmichael numbers of the form 3^a p q with 3<p<q admit a finite divisor parametrization for every fixed a. The specialization a=2 proves that 13833 and 321201 are the complete global 9pq list and resolves an internally inconsistent computation statement in the 2013 source.
limitations: The theorem treats 3^a p q with p and q distinct primes occurring to the first power. It does not classify larger p- or q-exponents or support with four or more distinct primes. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; the principal residual risk is equivalent coverage in older pseudo-Carmichael terminology, especially Wong's 1997 thesis, whose full text was not directly inspected from the checked source.

artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact-integer verification of the finite parametrization, direct divisibility cross-checks for small exponents, the complete a=2 candidate table, and the two exponent periods.
